name: Scene
garments: teased, multicolor-streaked hair with heavy side fringe

media.title: MySpace (platform, 2003–2011)
media.note: scene is arguably the most platform-specific aesthetic here — its photography style was built around MySpace's camera-angle conventions

reacts_against: emo's comparative restraint; scene pushed the same dark-plus-one-accent palette into louder, more colorful, more performed territory.
revivals: 2020s TikTok 'scene revival' content, largely as fashion nostalgia rather than a lived subculture

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Teased "raccoon tail" hair, side-swept bangs, skinny jeans, band tees, studded belts, bright accessories, heavy eyeliner, animal prints, checkerboard patterns
wiki_facts.key_colours: Black contrasted with bright neon colors (hot pink, electric blue, lime green)

wiki_facts.key_values: Individuality, self-expression, internet culture, music scenes (Warped Tour), playful rebellion

findings: mostly muted — about 64% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
